rubric_hint.rule: 3 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: 2.83 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified. Only an older felling (2014) overlaps, 0.067 ha (2.4%), so not already felled.
No eligible species within 250 m. Only 1 record in the 250 m ring, with no red-listed species; the 500 m ring has no threatened species either.

Three eligible (VU, site-bound, forest-associated, felling-relevant) species lie between 250 and 1000 m, all 2025 records with 10 m uncertainty: Goodyera repens (727 m), Skeletocutis brevispora (777 m) and Antrodiella citrinella (811 m). This gives MEDIUM under the rubric.

Several site-bound forest NT fungi are also recorded within 1000 m, such as Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum and Hermanssonia centrifuga, but none within 250 m, so they do not trigger the NT rule. Effort is adequate: 220 records on 40 days within 1000 m (90th percentile versus county median 66).

uncertainties: Eligible records are 727-811 m away, well beyond the site's 95 m equivalent radius, so they do not show the species are on or next to the site.
Near-site coverage is thin: 1 record on 1 day within 250 m and none inside, so the stand itself is barely documented.
854 coarse-uncertainty records were dropped from the 1000 m ring, so some nearby records may be unseen.
not_established: It is not established that any listed species occupies the polygon or its edge.
Absence of records inside the polygon does not mean absence of species.
Red List categories describe extinction risk, not legal protection.
The site is not shown to be safe to fell.
next_action: Human reviewer should check whether the stand has habitat similar to the nearby 2025 localities of Skeletocutis brevispora, Antrodiella citrinella and Goodyera repens, and consider a field check before felling begins.
